content: Node cannot resolve CDN import maps: verified empirically on Node v26 — package.json 'imports' mapping 'three' to an https URL throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (URL targets invalid in Node). If any module transitively imported by tests/*.test.js imports 'three', the whole node --test suite breaks. Keep the three import in a shell module (e.g. js/render-three.js) that tests never import; preserve the typeof document guard pattern.
